import io
import click
import pytest

EXPECTED_SYMPTOM = {
    "exception_type": "AssertionError",
    "message_regex": "Prompt with no suffix",
    "description": "click.prompt appends trailing space when prompt_suffix is empty",
    "target_symbols": ["click.termui.prompt"],
}

def test_reproduce_issue(monkeypatch, capfd):
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.stdin", io.StringIO("input_val\n"))
    click.prompt("Prompt with no suffix", prompt_suffix="")
    out, _ = capfd.readouterr()
    assert out == "Prompt with no suffix"
